items.stem: Why does an in-spreadsheet AI prompt usually work better when it references a specific range?

options.text: It gives the AI the exact data context to act on
options.rationale: Correct: scoping to a range improves relevance and accuracy.

options.text: It makes the workbook file smaller
options.rationale: Referencing a range does not shrink the file.

options.text: It prevents the AI from ever making mistakes
options.rationale: Context helps but does not guarantee correctness.

options.text: It disables all formulas in the sheet

items.explanation: Correct: a specific range gives the AI the right context instead of guessing which data to use.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO steps help verify AI-generated spreadsheet output? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Spot-check results against the source data
options.rationale: Correct: comparison to source catches wrong outputs.

options.text: Accept any formula that returns a number
options.rationale: A returned number can still be wrong.

options.text: Test a generated formula on known edge cases
options.rationale: Correct: edge-case testing reveals hidden errors.

options.text: Hide the formula so no one can question it
options.rationale: Hiding logic reduces, not improves, trust.

items.explanation: Correct: spot-checking against source data and testing a formula on edge cases both catch errors.

items.stem: AI suggests a pie chart for a 12-month sales trend. Why is this a poor choice?

options.text: Pie charts show parts of a whole, not change over time
options.rationale: Correct: trends are better shown with a line or column chart.

options.text: Pie charts cannot be made in spreadsheets
options.rationale: They can be made; they are just the wrong fit here.

options.text: Twelve months is too few to chart
options.rationale: Twelve points is fine to chart.

options.text: Charts should never be used for sales data
options.rationale: Charts are appropriate for sales data.

items.explanation: Correct: a pie chart hides change over time; a line or column chart shows a trend better.
